gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-cham: Spaced out and softly luxurious, Stentiga draws every stroke at a single width, crossbars included. Noto Sans Cham settles in below with rounded lowercase and open c shapes, a modern, clean counterweight.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Stentiga stretches out in refined spacing with uninterrupted monoline strokes, while Noto Sans Cherokee keeps short stalks and a gappy e. Let the heading go big and the body will hold up fine.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-chorasm: Stentiga lays out refined, luxurious letters with wide tracking and no brush-style swell in the curves. Noto Sans Chorasmian, large in x-height with curves that stop short, would start to outshout it if the heading shrank.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, with apertures left open throughout and ascenders that barely clear the lowercase. Stentiga is best at spaced-out luxury, the other at plain reading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Noto Sans Ethiopic is sturdy through the lowercase, with c terminals hanging well away from the bowl. Noto Sans Ethiopic gives Stentiga's refined, spread-out, uniform-width heading something solid to stand over.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Noto Sans Glagolitic keeps its round letters open and sturdy, so they read clearly even at small sizes. Shrink Stentiga, though, and its refined, luxurious spacing gets lost quickly.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has crayon-thick lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave a big gap. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi would keep paragraphs of text feeling modern and unhurried under Stentiga's refined spacing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Spaced out and quietly lavish, Stentiga looks as if a fixed-width nib drew it. Noto Sans Hanunoo then fills most of the line height with open terminals, which would keep paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP has a very large x-height and curves that sweep open rather than curl closed. But Stentiga's refined, luxurious heading wants generous size to let its wide tracking breathe.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: Noto Sans Kharoshthi leaves its curves open and lays a dense, dark band of lowercase across every line. Paragraphs would feel friendly and steady beneath Stentiga's refined, fixed-width pen line.
